input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: open-tennis-robots flagship 10: fit a drill's speed efficiency closer (its few speeds read 3-6% off)
errors: First venture-suite run failed RefitTest.test_a_wrong_launcher_model_is_corrected_mid_drill: it asserted the calibration fit returns a recovery time, which is now None by design (every drop is whole). Assertion updated.
Scratch harness hit ModuleNotFoundError 'protocol' importing controller directly; fixed by importing it through feeder_sim.

doc_friction.issue: On failure the summary shows only the tail of the last step's output (the CAD suite, all OK), so the failing test_host case was invisible; had to rerun unittest discover by hand to find it.

deviations.why: The flagship's next item was framed as a host-side fit problem; the diagnosis showed the drop measurement itself was the cause, so the fix went into the firmware (tach ring, per-shot fit) and the LAUNCH record's flags byte, not only launcher.py.
deviations.did: Firmware + host change with a backward-compatible flag bit.
deviations.result: Calibration speed error 3.9% to 1.9%, re-planned worst landing 1.18 m to 0.74 m (simulated).

notes: Diagnosis on the simulator: lowest-revolution drops read 62-99.5% of the true drop and the ((1-e^-x)/x)^2 share model's shape was wrong (loop reacts late via the 4-rev mean), so recovery time and speed efficiency traded. Prototyped estimators offline (linear/quadratic back-extrapolation, t0 grid); quadratic over 5 revs chosen (4,6,7 worse; tuned on the same sims, noted). Checks run here: venture suite (python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots), tests/launch_fit_sweep.py, tests/refit_sweep.py, tests/pulse_drop_sweep.py, post front-matter/link/similarity checks, venture-preflight. Remaining: speed reads +0.9..+1.9% on all 18 builds (bias); Refitter speed_tol (5%) not re-tuned; fit time on a real ESP32 and real tach jitter unmeasured.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: diagnosing the tach-share bias, prototyping estimators, firmware+host change, sweeps and docs: about a day and a half of an embedded engineer's work
